overall_reason: The one measured motion is the compare tray, which fades in at the bottom over 300 ms on its own curve when "Compare" is pressed and does a feedback job; the rest of the page declares Tailwind default timing, including "transition: all" at 300 ms on 20 elements and card lifts on hover.

score.reason: T-PURPOSE passes for the compare tray, but T-MOTION-SYSTEM finds default curves and "all" transitions and T-HOVER-SIGNAL finds stock card lifts.

findings.title: One curve family and one duration scale
findings.evidence: 65 of 67 transitioning elements use Tailwind's default cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) at 150 or 300 ms, 2 use the browser default ease at 200 ms, and the compare tray uses a third curve, cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.35, 1). The sweep's MOT-001 hits record 33 elements on "transition: all" at 0.3 s.
findings.before: Three unrelated curves and framework defaults, with "all" on 33 elements.
findings.after: Use one exit curve with two duration steps (about 150 ms for colour, 220 ms for movement) and list the animated properties.
findings.why: Default and mixed curves make the page's feedback feel unplanned, and "all" animates layout changes by accident.
findings.root: Tailwind transition utilities with no motion tokens

findings.title: Hover answers with one small signal
findings.evidence: The stylesheet declares ".hover:-translate-y-0.5:hover", ".hover:-translate-y-px:hover" and ".group:hover .group-hover:-translate-y-0.5", and 20 elements carry "transition: all 300ms" on the Tailwind curve, so cards lift on hover.
findings.before: Cards lift on hover on a 300 ms "all" transition.
findings.after: Keep one signal per card, such as a border colour change at 150 ms, and drop the lift.
findings.why: The same lift on every card is the stock hover and adds movement without new information.

strengths: The compare tray answers the "Compare" click with a short opacity fade (measured end 314 ms) and no travel, so the selection is confirmed without moving the page.
not_investigated: the "Close badge" trigger is the Base44 platform badge and changed instantly; not judged
